content.title: China calls halt to BHP iron ore cargoes during pricing talks, Bloomberg News reports
content.summary: MELBOURNE (Reuters) -China's state iron ore buyer has asked the country's steelmakers and traders to pause purchases of dollar-denominated seaborne iron ore cargoes from BHP during its annual price negotiations, Bloomberg News reported on Tuesday, citing people familiar with the matter.  China, the world's largest iron ore consumer, buys about 75% of global seaborne iron ore and set up China Mineral Resources Group (CMRG) three years ago to buy ore on behalf of its steelmakers to gain more leverage as a large, single buyer.
